ConnectionStrings._comment: Migrator uses the privileged dev owner (nexconvo); the runtime IdentityDb uses nexconvo_service so RLS is enforced. LOCAL-DEV only. Redis backs the distributed /me cache.

Jwt._comment: Issuer MUST be the URL the gateway uses to reach Identity — the discovery doc derives jwks_uri from it. Local dev: this service listens on 5047.

Internal._comment: Local non-Docker dev default only — env Internal__ApiKey overrides this in compose/prod.
